title: Viral Generator Framework — Framework Overview
description: The whole framework: components, pipeline, and how tools assemble from parts.

title: Viral Generator Framework — Prompt Processor
description: Normalizes prompts, extracts keywords, and detects intent.

title: Viral Generator Framework — Data Retriever
description: Deterministic template retrieval by seed and intent.

title: Viral Generator Framework — Generation Core
description: Combines processed prompts with retrieved material into concepts.

title: Viral Generator Framework — Renderer
description: Renders concepts to markdown, HTML, and plain text.

title: Viral Generator Framework — Output Validator
description: Schema and quality checks on generated concepts.

title: Viral Generator Framework — Personalizer
description: Applies runtime-supplied style and audience preferences; stores nothing.

title: Viral Generator Framework — Exporter
description: Packages concepts as JSON, markdown, HTML, or share-card text with attribution.
